learning: CBOR and MessagePack encode the same submitted value in different byte domains.
An unterminated complete JSONL record can be readable while still not being a durable line checkpoint.
Normalization and matching digests do not establish identity or authority.
A correct synthetic event reducer does not establish live delivery.
reset_redemption: Hamish alone; no agent redemption authority.
wellbeing_scope: No subjective wellbeing claim. Workload is tracked by files, bounded cases, failures and explicit stop conditions.
